verdict.rationale: All evidence shows Sketch ships a built-in MCP *server* that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude connect to and control Sketch (sketch-docs-49, sketch-docs-18, sketch-docs-34) — the reverse role of what the story asks. There is no evidence Sketch itself can act as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools; missing for 10: any documented mechanism for Sketch to consume/import external MCP servers' tools.
